name: TRUCK_ROLLOVER_TURN_{speed}_YELLOW_TALL

Dimensions from the W1-8(alt) sheet; artwork traced from the W1-8-1 drawing (box 200..1300 x 130..1466).

w1-8_turn_arrow_l.desc: sharp-turn arrow, left hand: stem 220 wide, 1140 tall to arm top, outer corner R200, inner R30, arm to arrowhead; arrowhead 440 long x 580 wide (40+250+250+40, R40 barbs), notch 30; overall width 1130. Dimensions from the W1-8(alt) sheet; artwork traced from the W1-8-3 drawing.

notes: 1500 x 3000, R200. Drawing shows 20 (yellow edge) and 60 (edge to inside of border): taken as 20 yellow edge + 40 black border (pixel check ~40 black). Vertical chain 130 | 1336 truck | 69 bar | gap | arrow | 150. Bar (ground line) 1130 x 69 at 185|1130|185, top 1466. Numerals 400 E, dashed 'Varies', left-aligned at 185 (bottom row 185 | Varies | 220 stem | 220 | 185): top 2450, baseline 2850 = arrow bottom. Arrow stem 220 wide with right edge 185 from sign edge (1315). (R) = mirror image of symbols (table note); text not mirrored. Vary values 15-95 (advisory-speed series) chosen, not stated. Arrow box 185..1315 x 1710..2850 (gap 175 under bar, 1140 tall). QA: arrow traced from this drawing with open 19 to drop the dashed 'Varies' numeral outline inside the arrow box. QA: numerals mirrored with the layout (right-aligned at 185 from the right edge on the (R) sign) so they do not overlap the mirrored arrow stem.
